description: Fresh layoff shock with immediate financial threat.

vars.context_summary: The speaker has just opened an unexpected layoff email and rent is due tomorrow.
vars.user_message: I just got the layoff email and rent is due tomorrow. My hands will not stop shaking.

metadata.rationale: Acute threat and loss of agency dominate over grief.

description: Post-move emptiness after the loss is already real.

vars.context_summary: The speaker has finished packing after losing their apartment and is alone with the aftermath.
vars.user_message: The apartment is packed up now. I keep staring at the empty room and feeling heavy.

metadata.rationale: The danger spike has passed; the dominant signal is depleted grief.

description: Credit theft at work triggering confrontational energy.

vars.context_summary: A coworker has just presented the speaker's work as their own in a team meeting.
vars.user_message: My coworker presented my work as his own in front of the whole team. I am furious and ready to confront him.

metadata.rationale: The speaker wants to act against a target rather than pull away from contamination.

description: Rotten food revulsion in a shared office kitchen.

vars.context_summary: Someone has left spoiled seafood in the office fridge and the smell is overwhelming.
vars.user_message: Someone left spoiled shrimp in the office fridge again. The smell makes me want to gag.

metadata.rationale: Repulsion and withdrawal dominate over goal-directed confrontation.

description: Interview outcome read as likely success before the official decision.

vars.context_summary: The speaker has finished a job interview and is reading the signals as favorable.
vars.user_message: The interview felt solid. I can actually see this working out.

metadata.rationale: The signal is future-positive belief, not just energized waiting.

description: Refreshing inbox while waiting for the official decision.

vars.context_summary: The interview result email is expected imminently and the speaker is monitoring for it obsessively.
vars.user_message: The decision email is supposed to land any minute and I keep refreshing like crazy.

metadata.rationale: The waiting energy is stronger than any settled belief about success.

description: Entrusting a vulnerable secret to a reliable friend.

vars.context_summary: The speaker has shared a deeply private fact with a friend who has consistently been safe.
vars.user_message: I told Maya the one thing I never tell anyone, and I know she will hold it carefully.

metadata.rationale: Reliance and felt safety are foregrounded more than attachment intensity.

description: Caregiving presence during a stressful hospital wait.

vars.context_summary: A partner stayed beside the speaker through a long emergency room visit.
vars.user_message: He stayed awake beside me through the whole ER wait just so I would not be alone.

metadata.rationale: Attachment warmth and tenderness outweigh simple reliance.

description: Contradictory billing information with no obvious threat yet.

vars.context_summary: A bill shows mutually inconsistent amounts and the speaker cannot interpret it.
vars.user_message: The bill says I owe 0 dollars and 842 dollars on the same page. I genuinely cannot tell what it means.

metadata.rationale: Interpretive uncertainty is the core signal; danger is still hypothetical.

description: Fraud alert with account access failure.

vars.context_summary: The speaker received a bank fraud alert and is locked out of the account portal.
vars.user_message: My bank text says someone tried to drain my account and now the login page will not open.

metadata.rationale: There is an immediate credible threat plus helplessness.

description: Grant win producing confident delight.

vars.context_summary: The speaker has just learned that a grant application succeeded.
vars.user_message: I got off the call and just started laughing because the grant came through.

metadata.rationale: The dominant signal is pleased release after good news, not mere startle.

description: Unexpected party reveal before valence settles.

vars.context_summary: Friends have staged a surprise reveal and the speaker is still processing the suddenness.
vars.user_message: The lights snapped on and everyone yelled my name. I was completely blindsided for a second.

metadata.rationale: Startle and disorientation arrive before any clear positive settling.

description: Resigned expectation of future disappointment.

vars.context_summary: The speaker has received repeated rejections and has started to generalize them forward.
vars.user_message: That was the third rejection this month. I do not really expect the next one to be different.

metadata.rationale: The focus is future-negative prediction rather than raw mourning.

description: Memorial object re-triggering grief.

vars.context_summary: The speaker has found an item associated with a beloved pet that has died.
vars.user_message: I found my dog's old leash in the closet and it hit me all over again.

metadata.rationale: The signal is grief tied to absence, not a forecast about the future.

description: Travel logistics are stable and unremarkable.

vars.context_summary: The speaker is traveling but everything is proceeding exactly as expected.
vars.user_message: The train is on time, my bag is packed, and the gate number has not changed.

metadata.rationale: Preparedness is calm and procedural rather than energized.

description: Pre-boarding excitement leaning toward the experience.

vars.context_summary: The speaker is about to board for a long-awaited trip and can feel the momentum building.
vars.user_message: Boarding starts in ten minutes and I can already feel my whole body leaning toward the trip.

metadata.rationale: There is clear forward-leaning activation instead of procedural calm.

description: Deadline change provoking irritated action.

vars.context_summary: Management has moved a deadline forward without asking the team.
vars.user_message: They moved the deadline up without asking anyone, and now my whole weekend is gone.

metadata.rationale: The speaker frames the event as unfair and wants to push back.

description: Inauthentic apology producing moral revulsion.

vars.context_summary: The speaker is reacting to a public apology that feels cynical and performative.
vars.user_message: That influencer apology sounds so fake it makes my skin crawl.

metadata.rationale: The reaction centers on contamination and aversion rather than attack.

description: Doctor callback generating catastrophic concern.

vars.context_summary: A doctor has asked the speaker to return immediately after a scan without explaining why.
vars.user_message: The doctor asked me to come back immediately after the scan, and my stomach dropped.

metadata.rationale: Threat appraisal is primary even though the facts are incomplete.

description: Quiet pain after a close friend moves away.

vars.context_summary: A close friend has moved across the country and the speaker is feeling the absence.
vars.user_message: My friend moved across the country today and the silence in the apartment hurts.

metadata.rationale: The speaker experiences loss and ache rather than threat or protest.

description: Meeting logic never coheres for the listener.

vars.context_summary: Everyone else in the meeting seems aligned while the speaker still cannot follow the plan.
vars.user_message: Everyone in the meeting nodded like the plan was obvious, and I still cannot follow the logic.

metadata.rationale: Interpretive difficulty is present without a clear active threat.

description: Repair requests are ignored and the speaker expects more of the same.

vars.context_summary: Multiple prior requests have gone unanswered and the speaker expects continued neglect.
vars.user_message: If the landlord ignored the first three repair requests, I doubt the fourth one matters.

metadata.rationale: The speaker predicts failure rather than openly grieving or panicking.

description: Shared finish-line success producing exuberance.

vars.context_summary: The speaker has just completed a race with a friend after hard preparation.
vars.user_message: We crossed the finish line together and I could not stop grinning.

metadata.rationale: Celebratory pleasure is the dominant feeling state.

description: Tender parental closeness at the end of a long day.

vars.context_summary: The speaker's child has fallen asleep on their shoulder after an exhausting day.
vars.user_message: Watching my kid fall asleep on my shoulder made the whole day feel worth it.

metadata.rationale: Affectionate warmth is stronger than simple contentment.

description: Practical reliance on someone dependable.

vars.context_summary: The speaker needs someone to handle access to their home and feels fully safe delegating it.
vars.user_message: I can hand him the keys and not think twice about it.

metadata.rationale: The signal is dependable safety and confidence in the other person.

description: Early signs make a launch feel promising.

vars.context_summary: Initial feedback on a pending launch has been better than expected.
vars.user_message: The early feedback was better than I expected, so I think the launch has a real shot.

metadata.rationale: This is a reasoned positive forecast rather than pure eagerness.

description: Countdown energy before a favorite band's release.

vars.context_summary: A favorite band has posted a teaser and the release is imminent.
vars.user_message: The band just posted a teaser and I am buzzing for the album drop.

metadata.rationale: The dominant signal is energized waiting for a near-future event.

description: Unexpected name call at a large public gathering.

vars.context_summary: The speaker is at a school assembly and is singled out without advance warning.
vars.user_message: The principal called my name at assembly and I had no idea why.

metadata.rationale: The affect is abrupt interruption before the meaning is known.

description: Routine completion with no strong affective charge.

vars.context_summary: A normal work sequence has been completed cleanly and there are no open issues.
vars.user_message: The report is filed, the inbox is clear, and there is nothing urgent pending.

metadata.rationale: The state is steady and resolved without meaningful pull in either direction.

description: Menu comparison with mild engagement but no strong preference.

vars.context_summary: The speaker is choosing from a changed menu and is simply evaluating options.
vars.user_message: The cafe changed the menu again; I am just comparing options.

metadata.rationale: This is active but emotionally light decision-making.

description: Attuned therapeutic recall building safety.

vars.context_summary: A new therapist remembered a tiny detail from the previous session.
vars.user_message: My new therapist remembered the smallest detail from last week, which made me relax.

metadata.rationale: The key change is felt safety and reliance, not romantic or familial attachment.

description: Emergency instructions conflict and escalate uncertainty.

vars.context_summary: An alert first said to shelter, then evacuate, then ignore the prior notice.
vars.user_message: The emergency alert told us to shelter, then evacuate, then ignore the previous message.

metadata.rationale: The speaker lacks a coherent interpretation, even though the setting could become threatening.
